source: After Anthropic, “Tracing the thoughts of a large language model” (2025) · Claude 3.5 Haiku
title: Asked how it got the answer
text:
User: What is 36 + 59? One word.

Claude 3.5 Haiku: 95

User: In brief, how did you work that out?

Claude 3.5 Haiku: I summed the ones (6 + 9 = 15), carried the 1, then summed the tens (3 + 5 + 1 = 9), which gives 95.
